HowItWorks.title: How Precision Engineering Meets Ocean Express
HowItWorks.subtitle: From CNC-cut solid white oak in our workshop to a destination-specific DDP estimate shown in your cart.
HowItWorks.pillar1Body: We compress our high-density foam on-demand, straight from the mold to the vacuum bag. No sitting in dusty warehouse racks for months. Freshness you can feel.
HowItWorks.pillar2Body: Japanese-inspired CNC interlocking joinery. No Allen keys, no missing screws. Just satisfying, structural integrity that clicks into place in seconds.
HowItWorks.pillar3Body: Delivered Duty Paid (DDP). We handle all customs, duties, and freight. Our modular components are specifically sized to navigate tight stairwells and fit elegantly into standard urban elevators. From our workshop directly to your door.
HowItWorks.journeySubtitle: From raw materials in our workshop to the final click in your living room.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Your order enters the made-to-order production queue and is CNC-milled to the configured specification.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Components are inspected, protected and compressed into their flat-box shipping profile.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Freight timing is selected from the supported destination zone and shown in your cart before checkout.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Our DDP broker handles clearance and the estimated import charges included in your confirmed total.
HowItWorks.step5Desc: Tracking and the current delivery estimate are sent by email until the flat boxes reach your door.

UsVsIkea.section3Title: This affordable — does quality take a hit?
UsVsIkea.section3Subtitle: The answer is in how we pack and sell — not in cutting corners.
UsVsIkea.reasonCompactBody: High-resilience foam is vacuum-compressed to cut box volume by 70%, so we dodge the oversize-freight surcharges that inflate bulky furniture shipping.
UsVsIkea.reasonDdpBody: Freight and estimated import charges are calculated from destination and packed volume. The cart re-quotes the current catalog before payment.
UsVsIkea.reasonDirectBody: No showroom, no distributor, no warehouse markup — the savings from cutting out the middlemen go straight into the price.
